title: For molecular polaritons, disorder and phonon timescales control the activation of dark states in the thermodynamic limit
summary: Collective light-matter systems host an extensive manifold of dark states whose role in the emergence of thermodynamic behavior remains poorly understood, especially in the presence of disorder and structured environments. Here, we develop a hybrid matrix product state-hierarchical equations of motion (MPS-HEOM) approach that enables numerically exact simulations of polariton dynamics from a few emitters to the thermodynamic limit under both static and dynamic disorder.
